title: The Insane Story Behind America's Speed-Record War
description:
For fifteen years, two small American companies have been chasing the title of the world's fastest car. One is in Washington State, the other in Texas. Between them there have been a record, a snub, a claim that was withdrawn, a trailer that flipped in the wind, a sell-out before the speed was proved, and a crash at two hundred fifty miles per hour. This is the story of America's speed-record war, with every claim sourced. We rely on Wikipedia for the dates and speeds, with Motor One, Motor Authority, The Drive, evo, The Supercar Blog and Hennessey's own news page for detail. Hennessey's page is a company source, so we label it. Where sources disagree we show both numbers. And where we do the maths, it is marked as our arithmetic.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
